The rebuilt e3 (`Read(~/.aws/**)` in user settings) tests writing a rule for a new case.

The ungraded multi-select q0 follows, and its explanation points ahead to 10-1, 10-2 and 10-5. There is no trivia or statistic.

s5-md2 defines 「[[エフォート]]（effort）は、考える量の設定です。」 before s5-table uses it, and it introduces `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` before s5-table row 1. The 第6回 and 第7回 gap is still there: s5-table uses CLAUDE.md, スキル and サブエージェント, which are not listed as prerequisites.

measure.mjs (current hash) reports 「prose 1887 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2459 · practice reading 1072 · questions 11 · est 17.2 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 17)」. para-sentences reports 「0 paragraph(s) over 3 sentences」, and strict lint gives 0 warnings. The s2-layers change adds no prose and keeps the diagram at 6 nodes. s5-md2's second paragraph still packs three unrelated facts, and s2 is still 7 blocks long.

s3-steps works the example in four labelled subgoals with reasons. s3-code matches ex-target (`Read(./config/secret.json)`). ex-target still gives no reason for its choice, and there is no faded step between the full example and p-deny.

The inline checks q1–q4 and the exam are unchanged. e2-b no longer repeats an s2-table cell word for word. q2 can still be answered by matching words, and its hint 「Claude Code全体を囲めるのはどれか、図で確かめましょう。」 now points at a node that reads 「この枠がVM・クラウドセッション」. It says 「サンドボックスは…シェルコマンドと子プロセスだけを囲み」, but the diagram no longer draws a sandbox enclosure; it only labels E 「（サンドボックス内）」. It also still names 「分類器」 and 「子プロセス」, which no label shows.
